name: The Little Guardians: Tower Defense
summary:
Bring a miniature battlefield to life in VR. Choose where your defenders stand and watch your plan unfold against incoming enemy waves.

Build around 13 guardian types with different attacks and roles. Mix rapid shots, chain attacks, slowing effects, holds, traps and heavy strikes. Read the incoming routes, cover the gaps and make your budget count.

Work through 200 campaign missions, unlock new guardian options and revisit completed missions with a different arrangement. Practice encounters help you learn
